parsed.rationale: Both `NowPlayingItem` (AppServices, `artwork:Image?`) and `PlaycutSelection` (app:iOS, `artwork:UIImage?`) are `type-alias-object` records sharing two fields — `playcut:Playcut` identically, and `artwork` differing only in platform image type (`Image?` vs `UIImage?`). This is the canonical PAT signal: same logical shape, one slot varies by a platform-specific type. Introducing a `PlaycutRepresentable` protocol with `associatedtype ArtworkImage` and required properties `artwork: ArtworkImage?` and `playcut: Playcut` lets both types conform without collapsing the platform distinction, while enabling shared downstream logic (e.g., playlist rendering, now-playing display) to be written generically against the protocol. Neither record carries any restraint marker (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app` all false), so the action signal is unobstructed.
